prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: single clean source image for an image-to-3D game building, not a UI or a whole scene.
Create one exceptionally charming toy-town SCHOOL matching the supplied approved town concept and bakery material reference. Image 1 is the accepted whole-town design: use the teal two-storey school with blue roof and round clock near the top center as the building identity. Image 2 is only the material and craftsmanship reference: rounded substantial forms, neat cream trims, tactile softly glossy painted toy surfaces. Do not reproduce the bakery, its awning or its bread oven.
The subject is a broad compact two-storey school shell. Teal painted walls; cream quoins, cornices and wide arched window frames; a rich clear blue tiled roof. The facade is symmetric with two simple classroom wings and a central slightly taller gable containing one large cream round clock with simple dark hands and dots, no numbers. At ground level a centered wide blue/teal arched double door with small warm brass handles, tall enough for the toy children. Above the door one restrained pair of windows. Two readable rows of windows on the wings. The shape feels lovingly designed and sculpted, not procedural primitives or flat illustration. Large clean bevels, softly rounded edges, broad economical roof tiles, very restrained detail.
The building should fit a roughly square footprint, target full roof width to depth about 1:1, total height about 0.72 of that width. Door threshold flush with ground, absolutely no staircase, front porch, raised platform or plinth. Very shallow roof eaves so they cannot hide the children at the front. Exactly two inhabited floors plus central clock gable, no additional floor or attic windows. All windows are opaque coloured toy glass, no transparent cutouts or modeled interior. No balconies, no hanging bell: the working school bell is a separate gameplay part.
Composition: only the isolated complete school on a clean warm off-white studio background, 3/4 perspective showing the front and right side with moderate elevation. Large in frame, entire roof and ground contact visible, generous unclipped margins, centered. Even soft studio light with gentle contact shadow, clear saturated colour, no dramatic black shadows, no exaggerated metallic specularity. This is an isolated 3D toy render suitable as a Tripo reference, not an isometric city scene.
No people, children, plants, trees, fences, vehicles, road, courtyard, base slab, lamp, cable, text, letters, labels, logos or watermark. Keep the central entrance unmistakable and accessible at ground level.
mode: built-in image_gen; references supply design and material style
status: First reference for Claude review; no Tripo order
inspection: Two floors, clock without numbers, ground-level door, no stairs/people/base. PNG does not confirm width/depth or door alignment.
